sources.title: A comparison of micrometeorological methods for marine roughness ...
sources.snippet: Abstract Marine roughness length z 0 is an essential parameter for the parameterization of momentum flux exchanges at sea-atmosphere interface. This paper aims to examine the performance of four widely adopted micrometeorological methods and four direct modeling methods, for estimating marine surface roughness at a coastal area.
